name: Assamite Sorcery (Awakening of the Steel) — Advanced — Strike at the True Flesh

system.description: You invoke the essential nature of your weapon and reduce your target to a similarly basic level, stripping away all supernatural defenses in a single devastating strike. Spend two Mental Traits in addition to this power's Blood Trait cost, then make an immediate attack with the sword as part of this action. The sword loses any supernatural modifiers to accuracy or damage, inflicting only its base damage for its type (though your own Potence, Celerity, and similar powers still affect your strength and speed normally). Your victim may not use any supernatural power — including Fortitude — to absorb, negate, redirect, or otherwise affect this damage. Any extra health levels are bypassed: if all normal Healthy levels are crossed off by this attack, further damage is applied directly to Bruised levels. Mundane body armor still provides its normal protection. You must have a total number of Ability Traits in Melee and Crafts: Blacksmith equal to your level of mastery in this path.
system.bloodCost: As per weapon-enchantment cost, plus 2 Mental Traits
